INSERT INTO categories (id, name, is_deleted, sync_logical_timestamp, sync_origin, sync_device_id)
               VALUES (?, ?, 0, ?, ?, ?)
               ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET
                   name = excluded.name,
                   is_deleted = 0,
                   sync_logical_timestamp = excluded.sync_logical_timestamp,
                   sync_origin = excluded.sync_origin,
                   sync_device_id = excluded.sync_device_id
